The '''Bisellia system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located in the [[Clacis sector/Legends|Clacis sector]], within the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] and [[New Territories/Legends|New Territories]] regions of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. The system was connected by the [[Entralla Route/Legends|Entralla Route]] [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]] to the [[Muunilinst system/Legends|Muunilinst]] and [[Endoraan system/Legends|Endoraan]] systems.<ref name="TEA" />

The Bisellia system fell within the borders of the [[Pentastar Alignment]] between the [[Standard year/Legends|years]] [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]] and [[12 ABY/Legends|12 ABY]], and was a part of the [[Imperial Remnant/Legends|Imperial Remnant]] between [[18 ABY/Legends|18 ABY]] and [[35 ABY/Legends|35 ABY]].<ref name="TEA" /> The system was the origin point of the [[Lobster Bisellian]] [[Foodstuff/Legends|meal]].<ref name="Maelstrom">[[Riders of the Maelstrom (adventure)|''Riders of the Maelstrom'']]</ref><ref name="Planetnamia">{{Planetnamia|other=the [[Lobster Bisellian]]|system=Bisellia [[Star system/Legends|system]]|legends=1}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Bisellia system was first mentioned in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', written by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Daniel Wallace]], which placed the system in grid square K-4.<ref name="TEA" />
